node.title: Re: awk cmd in perl (non-interpolated literal strings)
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
Due to lack of information I suppose you have an interpolation problem.

Please try either

  • 'singlequotes'
  • the [DOC://q|q]{uote-operator} with arbitrary delimiter (pairs)
  • <<'__here_docs__' surrounded by single-quotes.

see non-interpolating commands listed in [HTTPs://perldoc.perl.org/perlop.html#Quote-and-Quote-like-Operators|perlop#Quote-and-Quote-like-Operators] for further information.

HTH! :)

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
